text: `doc.GenMarkdownTree(cmd, dir)` generates Markdown pages for a command and all descendants. It calls `GenMarkdownTreeCustom` with an empty file prepender and identity link handler (`doc/md_docs.go:119-130`); the custom function recursively processes available non-help-topic children, then writes the current command to `<CommandPath_with_underscores>.md` (`doc/md_docs.go:131-158`).
